max_extents.description: Maximum number of extents allowed in the segment; NULL for partitioned tables.

pct_increase.description: Percentage increase in extent size; NULL for partitioned tables.

freelists.description: Number of process freelists allocated to the segment; NULL for partitioned tables.

freelist_groups.description: Number of freelist groups allocated to the segment; NULL for partitioned tables.

logging.description: Indicates whether or not changes to the table are logged; YES, NO, or NULL for partitioned tables.

backed_up.description: Indicates whether the table has been backed up since the last modification (Y) or not (N).

num_rows.description: Number of rows in the table.

blocks.description: Number of used data blocks in the table.

empty_blocks.description: Number of empty (never used) data blocks in the table. This column is populated only if you collect statistics on the table using the DBMS_STATS package.

avg_space.description: Average amount of free space, in bytes, in a data block allocated to the table.

chain_cnt.description: Number of rows in the table that are chained from one data block to another, or which have migrated to a new block, requiring a link to preserve the old ROWID.

avg_row_len.description: Average length of a row in the table (in bytes).

avg_space_freelist_blocks.description: Average freespace of all blocks on a freelist.

num_freelist_blocks.description: Number of blocks on the freelist.

degree.description: Number of threads per instance for scanning the table, or DEFAULT.

instances.description: Number of instances across which the table is to be scanned, or DEFAULT.

cache.description: Indicates whether the table is to be cached in the buffer cache (Y) or not (N).

table_lock.description: Indicates whether table locking is enabled (ENABLED) or disabled (DISABLED).

sample_size.description: Sample size used in analyzing this table.

last_analyzed.description: Date on which this table was most recently analyzed.

partitioned.description: Indicates whether the table is partitioned (YES) or not (NO).

iot_type.description: If the table is an index-organized table, then IOT_TYPE is IOT, IOT_OVERFLOW, or IOT_MAPPING. If the table is not an index-organized table, then IOT_TYPE is NULL.

temporary.description: Indicates whether the table is temporary (Y) or not (N).

secondary.description: Indicates whether the table is a secondary object created by the ODCIIndexCreate method of the Oracle Data Cartridge (Y) or not (N).

nested.description: Indicates whether the table is a nested table (YES) or not (NO).

flash_cache.description: Database Smart Flash Cache hint to be used for table blocks.

cell_flash_cache.description: Cell flash cache hint to be used for table blocks.

row_movement.description: Indicates whether partitioned row movement is enabled (ENABLED) or disabled (DISABLED).

global_stats.description: GLOBAL_STATS will be YES if statistics are gathered or incrementally maintained, otherwise it will be NO.

user_stats.description: Indicates whether statistics were entered directly by the user (YES) or not (NO).

duration.description: Indicates the duration of a temporary table.

skip_corrupt.description: Indicates whether Oracle Database ignores blocks marked corrupt during table and index scans (ENABLED) or raises an error (DISABLED). To enable this feature, run the DBMS_REPAIR.SKIP_CORRUPT_BLOCKS procedure.

monitoring.description: Indicates whether the table has the MONITORING attribute set (YES) or not (NO).

cluster_owner.description: Owner of the cluster, if any, to which the table belongs.

dependencies.description: Indicates whether row-level dependency tracking is enabled (ENABLED) or disabled (DISABLED).

compression.description: Indicates whether table compression is enabled (ENABLED) or not (DISABLED); NULL for partitioned tables.

compress_for.description: Default compression for what kind of operations:.

dropped.description: ndicates whether the table has been dropped and is in the recycle bin (YES) or not (NO); NULL for partitioned tables. This view does not return the names of tables that have been dropped.

read_only.description: Indicates whether the table segment is READ-ONLY or not.

segment_created.description: Indicates whether the table segment is created.

result_cache.description: Result cache mode annotation for the table.

clustering.description: Indicates whether the table has the attribute clustering clause (YES) or not (NO).

activity_tracking.description: Indicates whether Heat Map tracking is enabled on the table.

dml_timestamp.description: Modification time, creation time, or both for Automatic Data Optimization.

has_identity.description: Indicates whether the table has an identity column (YES) or not (NO).

container_data.description: Indicates whether the table contains container-specific data.

inmemory.description: Indicates whether the In-Memory Column Store (IM column store) is enabled (ENABLED) or disabled (DISABLED) for this table

inmemory_priority.description: Indicates the priority for In-Memory Column Store (IM column store) population.

inmemory_distribute.description: Indicates how the IM column store is distributed in an Oracle Real Application Clusters (Oracle RAC) environment.

inmemory_compression.description: Indicates the compression level for the IM column store.

inmemory_duplicate.description: Indicates the duplicate setting for the IM column store in an Oracle RAC environment.

duplicated.description: Indicates whether this object is duplicated on this shard (Y) or not (N).

sharded.description: Indicates whether this object is sharded (Y) or not (N).

external.description: Indicates whether the table is an external table (YES) or not (NO).

hybrid.description: Indicates whether the table is a hybrid partitioned table (YES) or not (NO). A hybrid partitioned table can contain a mixture of partitions stored in segments and partitions stored externally.

cellmemory.description: The value for columnar compression in the storage cell flash cache.

containers_default.description: Indicates whether the table is enabled for CONTAINERS() by default (YES) or not (NO).

container_map.description: Indicates whether the table is enabled for use with the container_map database property (YES) or not (NO).

extended_data_link.description: Indicates whether the table is enabled for fetching an extended data link from the root (YES) or not (NO).

inmemory_service.description: Indicates how the IM column store is populated on various instances.

inmemory_service_name.description: Indicates the service name for the service on which the IM column store should be populated. This column has a value only when the corresponding INMEMORY_SERVICE is USER_DEFINED. In all other cases, this column is null.

container_map_object.description: Indicates whether the table is used as the value of the container_map database property (YES) or not (NO).

memoptimize_read.description: Indicates whether the table is enabled for Fast Key Based Access (ENABLED) or not (DISABLED).

has_sensitive_column.description: Indicates whether the table has one or more sensitive columns (YES) or not (NO).

admit_null.description: Indicates whether the table admits null CON_ID data (YES) or not (NO).

data_link_dml_enabled.description: Indicates whether DML is permitted on the Data Link table (YES) or not (NO).

logical_replication.description: Indicates whether the table is enabled for logical replication (ENABLED) or not (DISABLED). This setting is ignored if database-wide column data supplemental logging is enabled.

hasMore.description: Indicates if there are more records to be retrieved.

limit.description: The actual page size limit on number of records applied by the server.

offset.description: The actual index from which the item resources are returned.

count.description: Total number of records in the current response.

DatabaseObjectsTypesItem.description: This object describes an object type in the database.

attributes.description: Number of attributes (if any) in the type.

methods.description: Number of methods (if any) in the type.

predefined.description: Indicates whether the type is a predefined type (YES) or not (NO).

incomplete.description: Indicates whether the type is an incomplete type (YES) or not (NO).

final.description: Indicates whether the type is a final type (YES) or not (NO).

instantiable.description: Indicates whether the type is an instantiable type (YES) or not (NO).

persistable.description: Indicates whether the type is a persistable type (YES) or not (NO).

supertype_owner.description: Owner of the supertype (NULL if type is not a subtype).

supertype_name.description: Name of the supertype (NULL if type is not a subtype).

local_attributes.description: Number of local (not inherited) attributes (if any) in the subtype.

local_methods.description: Number of local (not inherited) methods (if any) in the subtype.

typeid.description: Type ID value of the type.

hasMore.description: Indicates if there are more records to be retrieved.

limit.description: The actual page size limit on number of records applied by the server.

offset.description: The actual index from which the item resources are returned.

count.description: Total number of records in the current response.

DatabaseParametersItem.description: This documentation represents an initialization parameter that is currently in effect for the instance. A new session inherits parameter values from the instance-wide values. The list of attributes may vary depending on database version.

inst_id.description: Instance number from which the associated GV$SYSTEM_PARAMETER view information was obtained.

display_value.description: Parameter value in a user-friendly format. For example, if the VALUE column shows the value 262144 for a big integer parameter, then the DISPLAY_VALUE column will show the value 256K.

default_value.description: The default value for this parameter. This is the value of the parameter if a value is not explicitly specified for the parameter.

isdefault.description: Indicates whether the parameter is set to the default value (TRUE) or the parameter value was specified in the parameter file (FALSE). The database sets the value of the ISDEFAULT column to TRUE for parameters that are not specified in the init.ora or server parameter file (SPFILE).

isses_modifiable.description: Indicates whether the parameter can be changed with ALTER SESSION (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

issys_modifiable.description: Indicates whether the parameter can be changed with ALTER SYSTEM and when the change takes effect.

ispdb_modifiable.description: Indicates whether the parameter can be modified inside a PDB (TRUE) or not (FALSE). In a non-CDB, the value of this column is NULL.

isinstance_modifiable.description: For parameters that can be changed with ALTER SYSTEM, indicates whether the value of the parameter can be different for every instance (TRUE) or whether the parameter must have the same value for all Real Application Clusters instances (FALSE). If the ISSYS_MODIFIABLE column is FALSE, then this column is always FALSE.

ismodified.description: Indicates how the parameter was modified. If an ALTER SYSTEM was performed, the value will be MODIFIED.

isadjusted.description: Indicates whether Oracle adjusted the input value to a more suitable value (for example, the parameter value should be prime, but the user input a non-prime number, so Oracle adjusted the value to the next prime number).

isdeprecated.description: Indicates whether the parameter has been deprecated (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

isbasic.description: Indicates whether the parameter is a basic parameter (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

update_comment.description: Comments associated with the most recent update.

hash.description: Hash value for the parameter name.

con_id.description: The ID of the container to which the data pertains.

hasMore.description: Indicates if there are more records to be retrieved.

limit.description: The actual page size limit on number of records applied by the server.

offset.description: The actual index from which the item resources are returned.

count.description: Total number of records in the current response.

DatabasePluggableDatabasesItem.description: This object describes a Pluggable Database associated with the current instance. The list of attributes may vary depending on database version.

inst_id.description: Instance number from which the associated GV$PDBS view information was obtained.

con_id.description: The ID of the container to which the data pertains.

dbid.description: PDB identifier calculated when the PDB is created and stored in all file headers associated with the PDB.

con_uid.description: Unique identifier associated with the PDB.

guid.description: Globally unique identifier (GUID) of this PDB.

restricted.description: Indicates whether only users possessing RESTRICTED SESSION privilege can connect to the PDB.

open_time.description: Date and time when the database was last opened.

create_scn.description: System change number (SCN) for the creation of this PDB.

total_size.description: Shows the disk space (in bytes) used by the PBB, including both data and temp files.

block_size.description: The current block size for the PDB.

recovery_status.description: Shows whether recovery is enabled or disabled for the PDB.

snapshot_parent_con_id.description: This column shows the container ID of the master PDB that this PDB is a snapshot clone of. This column shows a nonzero value only if the PDB is a snapshot clone. For all other cases, it shows a value of 0.

application_root.description: Indicates whether the PDB is an application root.

application_pdb.description: Indicates whether the PDB is an application PDB.

application_seed.description: Indicates whether the PDB is an application seed (an application seed is also an application PDB).

application_root_con_id.description: If this PDB is an application PDB, the container ID of an application root to which this application PDB belongs. If this PDB is an application root clone, the container ID of an application root to which this application root clone belongs. Otherwise, NULL.

application_root_clone.description: Indicates whether this PDB is an application root clone (YES) or not (NO).

proxy_pdb.description: Indicates whether this PDB is a proxy PDB (YES) or not (NO).

local_undo.description: Shows whether the PDB is in local undo. This column is not relevant for CDB$ROOT.

undo_scn.description: System change number (SCN) at which the PDB was last converted from shared to local undo, or from local to shared undo. This column is not relevant for CDB$ROOT.

undo_timestamp.description: Date and time at which the PDB was last converted from shared to local undo, or from local to shared undo. This column is not relevant for CDB$ROOT.

creation_time.description: Date and time at which the PDB was created.

diagnostics_size.description: Shows the current disk space usage (in bytes) of the diagnostic traces generated in the PDB, which is represented by the CON_ID column of the row.

pdb_count.description: The number of user-created PDBs belonging to a given application root or CDB$ROOT. For all other containers, its value is 0.

audit_files_size.description: Shows the current disk space usage (in bytes) by Unified Audit files (.bin format) in the current PDB.

max_size.description: Shows the maximum amount of disk space (in bytes) that can  be used by data and temp files in the PDB.

max_diagnostics_size.description: Shows the maximum amount of disk space (in bytes) that can be used by diagnostic traces generated in the PDB.

max_audit_size.description: Shows the maximum amount of disk space (in bytes) that can be used by Unified Audit files (.bin format) in the PDB.

last_changed_by.description: Indicates what type of user last changed the PDB.

guid_base64.description: The GUID of the PDB, encoded in base64.

DatabasePluggableDatabaseStatusItem.description: This object describes the status of a Pluggable Database.

inst_id.description: Instance number from which the associated GV$PDBS view information was obtained.

con_id.description: The ID of the container to which the data pertains.

restricted.description: Indicates whether only users possessing RESTRICTED SESSION privilege can connect to the PDB.

hasMore.description: Indicates if there are more records to be retrieved.

limit.description: The actual page size limit on number of records applied by the server.

offset.description: The actual index from which the item resources are returned.

count.description: Total number of records in the current response.

PerformanceActionSessionHistoriesItem.description: This object represents a sampled session activity in the database from GV$ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY. It contains snapshots of active database sessions taken once a second. A database session is considered active if it was on the CPU or was waiting for an event that didn't belong to the Idle wait class. The list of attributes may vary depending on database version.

inst_id.description: Instance number from which the associated GV$ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY view information was obtained.

sample_time.description: Time at which the sample was taken.

is_awr_sample.description: Indicates whether this sample has been flushed or will be flushed to the Automatic Workload Repository (DBA_HIST_ACTIVE_SESS_HISTORY) (Y) or not (N).

session_serial#.description: Session serial number (used to uniquely identify a session's objects); maps to GV$SESSION.SERIAL#.

user_id.description: Oracle user identifier; maps to GV$SESSION.USER#.

sql_id.description: SQL identifier of the SQL statement that the session was executing at the time of sampling.

is_sqlid_current.description: Indicates whether the SQL identifier in the SQL_ID column is being executed (Y) or not (N).

sql_child_number.description: Child number of the SQL statement that the session was executing at the time of sampling.

sql_opcode.description: Indicates what phase of operation the SQL statement was in.

force_matching_signature.description: Signature used when the CURSOR_SHARING parameter is set to FORCE.

top_level_sql_id.description: SQL identifier of the top level SQL statement.

top_level_sql_opcode.description: Indicates what phase of operation the top level SQL statement was in.

sql_adaptive_plan_resolved.description: Indicates whether the SQL plan of the sampled database session is a resolved adaptive plan or not.

sql_full_plan_hash_value.description: Numerical representation of the complete SQL plan for the cursor being executed by this session.

sql_plan_hash_value.description: Numeric representation of the SQL plan for the cursor. This information might not be available for all session samples.

sql_exec_start.description: Time when the execution of the SQL started.

plsql_entry_object_id.description: Object ID of the top-most PL/SQL subprogram on the stack; NULL if there is no PL/SQL subprogram on the stack. Maps to DBA_OBJECTS.OBJECT_ID.

plsql_entry_subprogram_id.description: Subprogram ID of the top-most PL/SQL subprogram on the stack. Maps to DBA_OBJECTS.DATA_OBJECT_ID.

plsql_object_id.description: Object ID of the currently executing PL/SQL subprogram.

plsql_subprogram_id.description: Subprogram ID of the currently executing PL/SQL object.

qc_instance_id.description: Query coordinator instance ID. This information is only available if the sampled session is a parallel query slave. For all other sessions, the value is 0.

qc_session_id.description: Query coordinator session ID. This information is only available if the sampled session is a parallel query slave. For all other sessions, the value is 0.

qc_session_serial#.description: Query coordinator session serial number. This information is only available if the sampled session is a parallel query slave. For all other sessions, the value is 0.

event.description: If SESSION_STATE = WAITING, then the event for which the session was waiting for at the time of sampling. If SESSION_STATE = ON CPU, then this column is NULL.

event_id.description: Identifier of the resource or event for which the session is waiting or for which the session last waited. Interpretation is similar to that of the EVENT column.

event#.description: Number of the resource or event for which the session is waiting or for which the session last waited. Interpretation is similar to that of the EVENT column.

seq#.description: Sequence number that uniquely identifies the wait (incremented for each wait).

p1text.description: Description of the first wait event parameter.

p2text.description: Description of the second wait event parameter.

p3text.description: Description of the third wait event parameter.

wait_class.description: Wait class name of the event for which the session was waiting at the time of sampling.

wait_class_id.description: Wait class identifier of the event for which the session was waiting at the time of sampling.

wait_time.description: Total wait time for the event for which the session last waited if the session was on the CPU when sampled; 0 if the session was waiting at the time of sampling.

time_waited.description: If SESSION_STATE = WAITING, then the time that the session actually spent waiting for that event (in microseconds). This column is set for waits that were in progress at the time the sample was taken. If a wait event lasted for more than a second and was caught waiting in more than one session sample row, then the actual time spent waiting for that wait event will be populated in the last of those session sample rows. At any given time, this information will not be available for the latest session sample.

blocking_session.description: Session identifier of the blocking session. Populated only if the blocker is on the same instance and the session was waiting for enqueues or a 'buffer busy' wait.

blocking_session_serial#.description: Serial number of the blocking session.

blocking_inst_id.description: Instance number of the blocker shown in BLOCKING_SESSION.

blocking_hangchain_info.description: Indicates whether the information about BLOCKING_SESSION comes from the hang chain (Y) or not (N).

current_obj#.description: Object ID of the object that the session is referencing. This information is only available if the session was waiting for application, cluster, concurrency, and user I/O wait events.

current_file#.description: File number of the file containing the block that the session is referencing. This information is only available if the session was waiting for cluster, concurrency, and user I/O wait events.

current_block#.description: ID of the block that the session is referencing. This information is only available if the session was waiting for cluster, concurrency, and user I/O wait events.

current_row#.description: Row identifier that the session is referencing. This information is only available if the session was waiting for cluster, concurrency, and user I/O wait events.

xid.description: Transaction ID that the session was working on at the time of sampling.

remote_instance#.description: Remote instance identifier that will serve the block that this session is waiting for. This information is only available if the session was waiting for cluster events.

in_connection_mgmt.description: Indicates whether the session was doing connection management at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_parse.description: Indicates whether the session was parsing at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_hard_parse.description: Indicates whether the session was hard parsing at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_sql_execution.description: Indicates whether the session was executing SQL statements at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_plsql_execution.description: Indicates whether the session was executing PL/SQL at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_plsql_rpc.description: Indicates whether the session was executing inbound PL/SQL RPC calls at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_plsql_compilation.description: Indicates whether the session was compiling PL/SQL at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_java_execution.description: Indicates whether the session was executing Java at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_bind.description: Indicates whether the session was doing bind operations at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_cursor_close.description: Indicates whether the session was closing a cursor at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_sequence_load.description: Indicates whether the session is loading in sequence (in sequence load code) (Y) or not (N).

in_inmemory_query.description: Indicates whether the session was querying the In-Memory Column Store (IM column store) at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_inmemory_populate.description: Indicates whether the session was populating the IM column store at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_inmemory_prepopulate.description: Indicates whether the session was prepopulating the IM column store at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_inmemory_repopulate.description: Indicates whether the session was repopulating the IM column store at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_inmemory_trepopulate.description: Indicates whether the session was trickle repopulating the IM column store at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

in_tablespace_encryption.description: Indicates whether encryption or decryption of a tablespace occurred at the time of sampling (Y) or not (N).

capture_overhead.description: Indicates whether the session is executing capture code (Y) or not (N).

replay_overhead.description: Indicates whether the session is executing replay code (Y) or not (N).

is_captured.description: Indicates whether the session is being captured (Y) or not (N).

is_replayed.description: Indicates whether the session is being replayed (Y) or not (N).

is_replay_sync_token_holder.description: Indicates whether the session is holding a synchronization token (Y) or not (N) during workload replay.

program.description: Name of the operating system program.

module.description: Name of the executing module when sampled, as set by the DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_MODULE procedure.

action.description: Name of the executing module when sampled, as set by the DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_ACTION procedure.

ecid.description: Execution context identifier (sent by Application Server).

dbreplay_file_id.description: If the session is being captured or replayed, then DBREPLAY_FILE_ID is the file ID for the workload capture or workload replay; otherwise it is NULL.

dbreplay_call_counter.description: If the session is being captured or replayed, then DBREPLAY_CALL_COUNTER is the call counter of the user call that is being captured or replayed; otherwise it is NULL.

tm_delta_time.description: Time interval (in microseconds) over which TM_DELTA_CPU_TIME and TM_DELTA_DB_TIME are accumulated.

tm_delta_cpu_time.description: Amount of time this session spent on CPU over the last TM_DELTA_TIME microseconds.

tm_delta_db_time.description: Amount of time spent by this session in database calls over the last TM_DELTA_TIME microseconds.

delta_time.description: Time interval (in microseconds) since the last time this session was sampled or created, over which the next five statistics are accumulated.

delta_read_io_requests.description: Number of read I/O requests made by this session over the last DELTA_TIME microseconds.

delta_write_io_requests.description: Number of write I/O requests made by this session over the last DELTA_TIME microseconds.

delta_read_io_bytes.description: Number of I/O bytes read by this session over the last DELTA_TIME microseconds.

delta_write_io_bytes.description: Number of I/O bytes written by this session over the last DELTA_TIME microseconds.

delta_interconnect_io_bytes.description: Number of I/O bytes sent over the I/O interconnect over the last DELTA_TIME microseconds.

delta_read_mem_bytes.description: Number of read bytes through the buffer cache.

pga_allocated.description: Amount of PGA memory (in bytes) consumed by this session at the time this sample was taken.

temp_space_allocated.description: Amount of TEMP memory (in bytes) consumed by this session at the time this sample was taken.

con_id.description: The ID of the container to which the data pertains.

dbop_name.description: Database operation name. If the type is SQL, the DBOP_NAME will be NULL.

dbop_exec_id.description: Database operation execution identifier for the current execution. If the type is SQL, the DBOP_EXEC_ID will be NULL.

hasMore.description: Indicates if there are more records to be retrieved.

limit.description: The actual page size limit on number of records applied by the server.

offset.description: The actual index from which the item resources are returned.

count.description: Total number of records in the current response.

PerformanceActionSessionHistoryWaitsItem.description: Describes a wait event for a session. Data corresponds to a record from GV$SESSION_WAIT_HISTORY. The list of attributes may vary depending on database version.

username.description: Name of the user that is associated with the session.

inst_id.description: Instance number from which the associated V$ view information was obtained.

seq#.description: Sequence of wait events; 1 is the most recent.

event.description: Resource or event for which the session is waiting.

p1text.description: Description of the first wait event parameter.

p2text.description: Description of the second wait event parameter.

p3text.description: Description of the third wait event parameter.

wait_time.description: Amount of time waited (in hundredths of a second).

time_since_last_wait_micro.description: Time elapsed (in microseconds) since the end of the previous wait in the wait history.

con_id.description: The ID of the container to which the data pertains.

PerformanceActionSessionHistoryWaitsActi.description: Describes statistics on an SQL statement that is in memory, parsed and ready for execution but waiting on an event. The list of attributes may vary depending on database version.

username.description: Name of the user that is associated with the session that is waiting.

inst_id.description: Instance number from which the associated V$ view information was obtained.

sql_text.description: First thousand characters of the SQL text for the current cursor.

sql_fulltext.description: All characters of the SQL text for the current cursor.

sql_id.description: SQL identifier of the parent cursor in the library cache.

sharable_mem.description: Amount of shared memory used by a cursor. If multiple child cursors exist, then the sum of all shared memory used by all child cursors.

persistent_mem.description: Fixed amount of memory used for the lifetime of an open cursor. If multiple child cursors exist, then the fixed sum of memory used for the lifetime of all the child cursors.

runtime_mem.description: Fixed amount of memory required during execution of a cursor. If multiple child cursors exist, then the fixed sum of all memory required during execution of all the child cursors.

sorts.description: Sum of the number of sorts that were done for all the child cursors.

version_count.description: Number of child cursors that are present in the cache under this parent.

loaded_versions.description: Number of child cursors that are present in the cache and have their context heap loaded.

open_versions.description: Number of child cursors that are currently open under this current parent.

users_opening.description: Number of users that have any of the child cursors open.

fetches.description: Number of fetches associated with the SQL statement.

executions.description: Total number of executions, totalled over all the child cursors.

px_servers_executions.description: Total number of executions performed by parallel execution servers (0 when the statement has never been executed in parallel).

end_of_fetch_count.description: Number of times this cursor was fully executed since the cursor was brought into the library cache. The value of this statistic is not incremented when the cursor is partially executed, either because it failed during the execution or because only the first few rows produced by this cursor are fetched before the cursor is closed or re-executed. By definition, the value of the END_OF_FETCH_COUNT column should be less or equal to the value of the EXECUTIONS column.

users_executing.description: Total number of users executing the statement over all child cursors.

loads.description: Number of times the object was loaded or reloaded.

first_load_time.description: Timestamp of the parent creation time.

invalidations.description: Total number of invalidations over all the child cursors.

parse_calls.description: Sum of all parse calls to all the child cursors under this parent.

disk_reads.description: Sum of the number of disk reads over all child cursors.

direct_writes.description: Sum of the number of direct writes over all child cursors.

direct_reads.description: Sum of the number of direct reads over all child cursors.

buffer_gets.description: Sum of buffer gets over all child cursors.

rows_processed.description: Total number of rows processed on behalf of this SQL statement.

optimizer_mode.description: Mode under which the SQL statement was executed.

optimizer_cost.description: Cost of this query given by the optimizer.

optimizer_env_hash_value.description: Hash value for the optimizer environment.

parsing_user_id.description: User ID of the user that has parsed the very first cursor under this parent.

parsing_schema_id.description: Schema ID that was used to parse this child cursor.

parsing_schema_name.description: Schema name that was used to parse this child cursor.

kept_versions.description: Number of child cursors that have been marked to be kept using the DBMS_SHARED_POOL package.

address.description: Address of the handle to the parent for this cursor.

hash_value.description: Hash value of the parent statement in the library cache.

plan_hash_value.description: Numeric representation of the current SQL plan for this cursor. Comparing one PLAN_HASH_VALUE to another easily identifies whether or not two plans are the same (rather than comparing the two plans line by line).

full_plan_hash_value.description: Numeric representation of the complete SQL plan for this cursor. Comparing one FULL_PLAN_HASH_VALUE to another easily identifies whether or not two plans are the same (rather than comparing the two plans line by line). Note that the FULL_PLAN_HASH_VALUE cannot be compared across databases releases. It is not backward compatible.

module.description: Contains the name of the module that was executing when the SQL statement was first parsed as set by calling DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_MODULE

module_hash.description: Hash value of the module that is named in the MODULE column.

action.description: Contains the name of the action that was executing when the SQL statement was first parsed as set by calling DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_ACTION.

action_hash.description: Hash value of the action that is named in the ACTION column.

serializable_aborts.description: Number of times the transaction failed to serialize, producing ORA-08177 errors, totalled over all the child cursors.

outline_category.description: If an outline was applied during construction of the cursor, then this column displays the category of that outline. Otherwise the column is left blank..

cpu_time.description: CPU time (in microseconds) used by this cursor for parsing, executing, and fetching.

elapsed_time.description: Elapsed time (in microseconds) used by this cursor for parsing, executing, and fetching. If the cursor uses parallel execution, then ELAPSED_TIME is the cumulative time for the query coordinator, plus all parallel query slave processes.

last_active_child_address.description: Address (identifier) of the child cursor that was the last to be active in the group (that is, the child cursor on behalf of which statistics in GV$SQL were updated).

remote.description: Indicates whether the cursor is remote mapped (Y) or not (N).

literal_hash_value.description: Hash value of the literals which are replaced with system-generated bind variables and are to be matched, when CURSOR_SHARING is used. This is not the hash value for the SQL statement. If CURSOR_SHARING is not used, then the value is 0.

last_load_time.description: Time at which the query plan was loaded into the library cache.

is_obsolete.description: Indicates whether the cursor has become obsolete (Y) or not (N). This can happen if the number of child cursors is too large.

is_bind_sensitive.description: Indicates whether the cursor is bind sensitive (Y) or not (N). A query is considered bind-sensitive if the optimizer peeked at one of its bind variable values when computing predicate selectivities and where a change in a bind variable value may cause the optimizer to generate a different plan.

is_bind_aware.description: Indicates whether the cursor is bind aware (Y) or not (N). A query is considered bind-aware if it has been marked to use extended cursor sharing. The query would already have been marked as bind-sensitive.

child_latch.description: Child latch number that is protecting the cursor. This column is obsolete and maintained for backward compatibility.

sql_profile.description: SQL profile used for this statement, if any.

sql_patch.description: SQL patch used for this statement, if any.

sql_plan_baseline.description: SQL plan baseline used for this statement, if any.

exact_matching_signature.description: Signature used when the CURSOR_SHARING parameter is set to EXACT.

force_matching_signature.description: Signature used when the CURSOR_SHARING parameter is set to FORCE.

last_active_time.description: Time at which the query plan was last active.

io_cell_offload_eligible_bytes.description: Number of I/O bytes which can be filtered by the Exadata storage system.

io_interconnect_bytes.description: Number of I/O bytes exchanged between Oracle Database and the storage system.

physical_read_requests.description: Number of physical read I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

physical_read_bytes.description: Number of bytes read from disks by the monitored SQL.

physical_write_requests.description: Number of physical write I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

physical_write_bytes.description: Number of bytes written to disks by the monitored SQL.

optimized_phy_read_requests.description: Number of physical read I/O requests from Database Smart Flash Cache issued by the monitored SQL.

locked_total.description: Total number of times the child cursor has been locked.

pinned_total.description: Total number of times the child cursor has been pinned.

io_cell_uncompressed_bytes.description: Number of uncompressed bytes (that is, size after decompression) that are offloaded to the Exadata cells.

io_cell_offload_returned_bytes.description: Number of bytes that are returned by Exadata cell through the regular I/O path.

con_id.description: The ID of the container to which the data pertains.

is_reoptimizable.description: This columns shows whether the next execution matching this child cursor will trigger a reoptimization.

is_resolved_adaptive_plan.description: This column shows whether all of the adaptive parts of a plan have been resolved to the final plan.

hasMore.description: Indicates if there are more records to be retrieved.

limit.description: The actual page size limit on number of records applied by the server.

offset.description: The actual index from which the item resources are returned.

count.description: Total number of records in the current response.

PerformanceSQLStatementsItem.description: This object describes an SQL statement. The list of attributes may vary depending on database version.

elapsed_time.description: Elapsed time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

sql_exec_id.description: SQL execution identifier; NULL if SQL_ID is NULL or if the execution of that SQL has not yet started.

duration.description: Indicates the length of time the SQL statement has been running for. Calculated based on SQL_EXEC_START and LAST_REFRESH_TIME from GV$SQL_MONITOR.

session_id.description: Session identifier executing (or having executed) the SQL statement being monitored.

session_serial.description: Session serial number executing the statement being monitored.

instance_dop.description: Distinct number of instances that the SQL statement executed compared with the logical parallel execution server process number executing (or having executed) the statement being monitored.

cpu_time.description: Sum of total CPU time; updated as the statement executes.

io_time.description: Sum of total User I/O Wait Time; updated as the statement executes

sql_exec_start.description: Time when the execution started. Part of the execution key for identifying a single record in GV$SQL_MONITOR.

end_time.description: When the status is 'DONE (ALL ROWS)' this is the LAST_REFRESH_TIME value from GV$SQL_MONITOR.

sql_fulltext.description: All characters of the SQL text for the current cursor.

con_id.description: The ID of the container to which the data pertains.

hasMore.description: Indicates if there are more records to be retrieved.

limit.description: The actual page size limit on number of records applied by the server.

offset.description: The actual index from which the item resources are returned.

count.description: Total number of records in the current response.

PerformanceSQLStatementMonitorsItem.description: This object provides statistics for a single execution of an SQL statement. The list of attributes may vary depending on database version.

inst_id.description: Instance number from which the associated GV$SQL_MONITOR view information was obtained.

key.description: Artificial join key to efficiently join GV$SQL_MONITOR with its corresponding plan level monitoring statistics stored in GV$SQL_PLAN_MONITOR.

report_id.description: Unique ID of the XML report stored in Automatic Workload Repository (AWR) for this monitored entity.

user#.description: User ID of the database user who issued the SQL being monitored.

username.description: User name of the database user who issued the SQL being monitored.

module.description: Name of the executing module when sampled, as set by the DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_MODULE procedure.

action.description: Name of the executing action when sampled, as set by the DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_ACTION procedure.

service_name.description: Service name of the user session.

client_identifier.description: Client identifier from the user session.

client_info.description: Client information for the user session.

program.description: Name of the operating system program that issued the monitored SQL.

plsql_entry_object_id.description: Object ID of the top-most PL/SQL subprogram on the stack; NULL if there is no PL/SQL subprogram on the stack.

plsql_entry_subprogram_id.description: Subprogram ID of the top-most PL/SQL subprogram on the stack; NULL if there is no PL/SQL subprogram on the stack.

plsql_object_id.description: Object ID of the currently executing PL/SQL subprogram; NULL if executing SQL.

plsql_subprogram_id.description: Subprogram ID of the currently executing PL/SQL object; NULL if executing SQL.

first_refresh_time.description: Time when monitoring of the SQL statement started, generally a few seconds after execution start time.

last_refresh_time.description: Time when statistics in V$SQL_MONITOR were last updated for the SQL statement. Statistics are generally refreshed every second when the statement executes.

refresh_count.description: Number of times V$SQL_MONITOR statistics have been refreshed (generally once every second when the SQL statement executes).

dbop_exec_id.description: Database operation execution identifier for the current execution. If the type is SQL, the DBOP_EXEC_ID will be NULL.

dbop_name.description: Database operation name. If the type is SQL, the DBOP_NAME will be NULL.

sid.description: Session identifier executing (or having executed) the SQL statement being monitored.

process_name.description: Process name identifier executing (or having executed)the statement; ora if the process is foreground, else the background process name (for example, p001 for PX server p001).

sql_id.description: SQL identifier of the statement being monitored.

sql_text.description: Up to the first 2000 characters of the text of the SQL being monitored.

is_full_sqltext.description: Indicates whether the SQL_TEXT column has the entire SQL text (Y) or not (N).

sql_exec_id.description: Execution identifier. Together, the three columns SQL_ID, SQL_EXEC_START, and SQL_EXEC_ID represent the execution key. The execution key is used to uniquely identify one execution of the SQL statement.

sql_full_plan_hash_value.description: Numeric representation of the complete SQL plan for this cursor. Comparing one SQL_FULL_PLAN_HASH_VALUE to another easily identifies whether or not two plans are the same (rather than comparing the two plans line by line). Note that the SQL_FULL_PLAN_HASH_VALUE cannot be compared across databases releases. It is not backward compatible.

exact_matching_signature.description: Signature calculated on the normalized SQL text. The normalization includes the removal of white space and the uppercasing of all non-literal strings.

force_matching_signature.description: Same as EXACT_MATCHING_SIGNATURE but literals in the SQL text are replaced by binds.

sql_child_address.description: Address of the child cursor (can be used with SQL_ID to join with GV$SQL).

session_serial#.description: Session serial number executing the statement being monitored.

px_is_cross_instance.description: Indicates whether the SQL statement ran parallel across multiple instances (Y) or not (N).

px_maxdop.description: Maximum degree of parallelism for any plan operation executed on behalf of the monitored SQL.

px_maxdop_instances.description: Number of database instances touched at the maximum degree of parallelism.

px_servers_requested.description: Total number of parallel execution servers requested to execute the monitored SQL.

px_servers_allocated.description: Actual number of parallel execution servers allocated to execute the query

px_server#.description: Logical parallel execution server process number executing (or having executed) the statement being monitored; NULL if this monitoring entry is not associated with an execution server. This is a logical number within the parallel server set (see SERVER# in V$PX_SESSION).

px_server_group.description: Logical parallel execution server group number to which PX_SERVER# belongs (see SERVER_GROUP in V$PX_SESSION); NULL if this monitoring entry is not associated with a parallel execution server. This value is generally 1 unless the SQL statement has one or more parallel sub-queries.

px_server_set.description: Number (1 or 2) of the logical set of parallel execution servers to which PX_SERVER# belongs (see SERVER_SET in V$PX_SESSION); NULL if this monitoring entry is not associated with a parallel execution server.

px_qcinst_id.description: Instance identifier where the parallel execution coordinator runs; NULL if PX_SERVER# is NULL.

px_qcsid.description: Session identifier for the parallel execution coordinator; NULL if PX_SERVER# is NULL.

error_number.description: Error number encountered in case a SQL fails to execute successfully (for example, 932 in case of ORA-00932).

error_facility.description: Error facility in case a SQL fails to execute successfully (for example, ORA in case of ORA-00932).

error_message.description: Detailed error message displayed corresponding to the error number and error facility when a SQL fails to execute successfully.

binds_xml.description: Information about bind variables used with the SQL, such as name, position, value, data type, and so on (stored in XML format).

other_xml.description: Additional information about SQL execution stored in XML format.

elapsed_time.description: Elapsed time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

queuing_time.description: Duration of time (in microseconds) spent by SQL in the statement queue.

cpu_time.description: CPU time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

fetches.description: Number of fetches associated with the SQL statement; updated as the statement executes.

buffer_gets.description: Number of buffer get operations; updated as the statement executes.

disk_reads.description: Number of disk reads; updated as the statement executes.

direct_writes.description: Number of direct writes; updated as the statement executes.

io_interconnect_bytes.description: Number of I/O bytes exchanged between Oracle Database and the storage system.

physical_read_requests.description: Number of physical read I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

physical_read_bytes.description: Number of bytes read from disks by the monitored SQL.

physical_write_requests.description: Number of physical write I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

physical_write_bytes.description: Number of bytes written to disks by the monitored SQL.

application_wait_time.description: Application wait time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

concurrency_wait_time.description: Concurrency wait time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

cluster_wait_time.description: Cluster wait time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

user_io_wait_time.description: User I/O Wait Time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

plsql_exec_time.description: PL/SQL execution time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

java_exec_time.description: Java execution time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

rm_last_action.description: The most recent action that was taken on this SQL operation by Resource Manager.

rm_last_action_reason.description: The reason for the most recent action that was taken on this SQL operation by Resource Manager.

rm_last_action_time.description: The time of the most recent action that was taken on this SQL operation by Resource Manager.

rm_consumer_group.description: The current consumer group for this SQL operation.

con_id.description: The ID of the container to which the data pertains.

con_name.description: Container name of the object. The value of this column is NULL in non-CDBs.

ecid.description: Execution context identifier (sent by Application Server).

is_adaptive_plan.description: Indicates whether the statistics are from an adaptive plan (Y) or not (N).

is_final_plan.description: Indicates whether the statistics are from the final plan (Y) or not (N).

in_dbop_name.description: If the SQL that is monitored was executed by a session that was also monitored by a database operation (DBOP), then this column specifies the name of that DBOP.

in_dbop_exec_id.description: If the SQL that is monitored was executed by a session that was also monitored by a database operation (DBOP), then this column specifies the execution ID of that DBO.

io_cell_uncompressed_bytes.description: Number of uncompressed bytes (that is, size after decompression) that are offloaded to the Exadata cells.

io_cell_offload_eligible_bytes.description: Number of I/O bytes which can be filtered by the Exadata storage system.

io_cell_offload_returned_bytes.description: Number of filtered bytes returned by Exadata cells (that is, the number of bytes returned after  processing has been offloaded on the Exadata cells).

current_user.description: Unique number identifying the current user.

PerformanceSQLStatementMonitorParallelis.description: Describes the parallel execution of an SQL Statement. Using GV$SQL_MONITOR view, the information includes the Parallel Coordinator and the instance(s) where it was executed.

node_id.description: Used as a distinguishing value in the Parallelism metadata. The value may be an Instance Number to represent the execution on an instance, 10000 when a Parallel Coordinator or some other value derived from the SERVER_GROUP data.

parent_node_id.description: The value may be an Instance Number to represent the execution of Parallel Coordinator or Server Group on an instance. May be NULL.

name.description: Name of either the Instance, Parallel Coordinator, Parellel Group, Parallel Set or Parallel Server that corresponds to the GV$SQL_MONITOR record.

inst_id.description: The Instance Number from the GV$SQL_MONITOR record.

server_set.description: Number (1 or 2) of the logical set of parallel execution servers to which PX_SERVER# belongs (see SERVER_SET in V$PX_SESSION); NULL if this monitoring entry is not associated with a parallel execution server.

process_name.description: Process name identifier executing (or having executed)the statement; ora if the process is foreground, else the background process name (for example, p001 for PX server p001).

db_time.description: The greater of either ELAPSED_TIME or a total of the following CPU_TIME + QUEUING_TIME + APPLICATION_WAIT_TIME + CONCURRENCY_WAIT_TIME + CLUSTER_WAIT_TIME + USER_IO_WAIT_TIME + PLSQL_EXEC_TIME + JAVA_EXEC_TIME.

db_time_prop.description: The proportional time spent for this GV$SQL_MONITOR record compared to other execution records for the same SQL Statement.

db_time_max.description: The maximum time spent for an execution of the SQL Statement.

cpu_time.description: CPU time (in microseconds) used by this cursor for parsing, executing, and fetching.

queuing_time.description: Duration of time (in microseconds) spent by SQL in the statement queue.

application_wait_time.description: Application wait time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

concurrency_wait_time.description: Concurrency wait time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

cluster_wait_time.description: Cluster wait time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

user_io_wait_time.description: User I/O Wait Time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

plsql_exec_time.description: PL/SQL execution time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

java_exec_time.description: Java execution time (in microseconds); updated as the statement executes.

other_wait_time.description: The greater of either zero or a total of the following CPU_TIME - QUEUING_TIME - APPLICATION_WAIT_TIME - CONCURRENCY_WAIT_TIME - CLUSTER_WAIT_TIME - USER_IO_WAIT_TIME - PLSQL_EXEC_TIME - JAVA_EXEC_TIME.

io_requests.description: Total of number of physical read and write I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

io_requests_prop.description: The proportional number of physical read and write I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL compared to other execution records for the same SQL Statement.

io_requests_max.description: The maximum number of physical read and write I/O requests issued by a monitored SQL execution for the same SQL Statement.

io_bytes.description: Total of number of bytes read from disks and bytes written to disks by the monitored SQL.

io_bytes_prop.description: The proportional number of bytes read from disks and bytes written to disks by the monitored SQL compared to other execution records for the same SQL Statement.

io_bytes_max.description: The maximum number of bytes read from disks and bytes written to disks by a monitored SQL execution for the same SQL Statement.

buffer_gets.description: Number of buffer get operations; updated as the statement executes.

buffer_gets_prop.description: The proportional number of buffer get operations compared to other execution records for the same SQL Statement.

buffer_gets_max.description: The maximum number of buffer get operations by a monitored SQL execution for the same SQL Statement.

dop_downgrade.description: Percentage of actual number of parallel execution servers allocated to execute the query compared to the total number of parallel execution servers requested to execute the query.

servers_requested.description: Total number of parallel execution servers requested to execute the monitored SQL.

servers_allocated.description: Actual number of parallel execution servers allocated to execute the query.

hasMore.description: Indicates if there are more records to be retrieved.

limit.description: The actual page size limit on number of records applied by the server.

offset.description: The actual index from which the item resources are returned.

count.description: Total number of records in the current response.

PerformanceSQLStatementPlanItem.description: Describes the explain plan for an SQL Statement.

id.description: A number assigned to each step in the execution plan.

depth.description: Depth (or level) of the operation in the tree. The root operation (statement) is level 0.

operation.description: Name of the internal operation performed in this step (for example, TABLE ACCESS).

rows.description: The number of rows the optimizer is expecting the operation to produce each time it is called. Also known as E-Rows.

rowsourcetimes.description: The number of times the SQL Statement is referenced in GV$ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY.

hasMore.description: Indicates if there are more records to be retrieved.

limit.description: The actual page size limit on number of records applied by the server.

offset.description: The actual index from which the item resources are returned.

count.description: Total number of records in the current response.

PerformanceSQLStatementHistoryItem.description: This object represents historical information about SQL statistics. The structure is based on DBA_HIST_SQLSTAT. The list of attributes may vary depending on database version.

begin_interval_time_utc.description: Time at the beginning of the snapshot interval in UTC timezone.

begin_interval_time.description: Time at the beginning of the snapshot interval.

end_interval_time.description: Time at the end of the snapshot interval; the actual time the snapshot was taken.

flush_elapsed.description: Amount of time to perform the snapshot.

error_count.description: Number of errors occurring in the tables for the particular snapshot.

snap_flag.description: Condition under which the snapshot was inserted.

snap_timezone.description: Snapshot time zone expressed as offset from UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) time zone.

sql_id.description: SQL identifier of the parent cursor in the library cache.

plan_hash_value.description: Numerical representation of the SQL plan for the cursor. Comparing one PLAN_HASH_VALUE to another easily identifies whether or not two plans are the same (rather than comparing the two plans line by line).

optimizer_cost.description: Cost of the query given by the optimizer.

optimizer_mode.description: Mode under which the SQL statement is executed.

optimizer_env_hash_value.description: Hash Value for the optimizer environment.

sharable_mem.description: Amount of shared memory used by the child cursor (in bytes).

loaded_versions.description: Indicates whether the context heap is loaded (1) or not (0).

version_count.description: Number of children associated with the cursor.

module.description: Contains the name of the module that was executing at the time that the SQL statement was first parsed, which is set by calling DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_MODULE.

action.description: Contains the name of the action that was executing at the time that the SQL statement was first parsed, which is set by calling DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_ACTION.

sql_profile.description: Name of the applied SQL Profile.

force_matching_signature.description: The signature used when the CURSOR_SHARING parameter is set to FORCE.

parsing_schema_id.description: Schema ID that was used to originally build the child cursor.

parsing_schema_name.description: Schema name that was used to originally build the child cursor.

parsing_user_id.description: User ID that was used to originally build the child cursor.

fetches_total.description: Cumulative number of fetches associated with the SQL statement.

fetches_delta.description: Delta number of fetches associated with the SQL statement.

end_of_fetch_count_total.description: Cumulative number of times this cursor was fully executed since the cursor was brought into the library cache. The value of this statistic is not incremented when the cursor is partially executed, either because it failed during the execution or because only the first few rows produced by this cursor are fetched before the cursor is closed or re-executed. By definition, the value of the END_OF_FETCH_COUNT column should be less or equal to the value of the EXECUTIONS column.

end_of_fetch_count_delta.description: Delta number of times this cursor was fully executed since the cursor was brought into the library cache. The value of this statistic is not incremented when the cursor is partially executed, either because it failed during the execution or because only the first few rows produced by this cursor are fetched before the cursor is closed or re-executed.

sorts_total.description: Cumulative number of sorts that were done for this child cursor.

sorts_delta.description: Delta number of sorts that were done for this child cursor.

executions_total.description: Cumulative number of executions that took place on this object since it was brought into the library cache.

executions_delta.description: Delta number of executions that took place on this object since it was brought into the library cache.

px_servers_execs_total.description: Cumulative number of PX server executions.

px_servers_execs_delta.description: Delta number of PX server executions.

loads_total.description: Cumulative number of times the object was either loaded or reloaded.

loads_delta.description: Delta number of times the object was either loaded or reloaded.

invalidations_total.description: Cumulative number of times this child cursor has been invalidated.

invalidations_delta.description: Delta number of times this child cursor has been invalidated.

parse_calls_total.description: Cumulative number of parse calls for this child cursor.

parse_calls_delta.description: Delta number of parse calls for this child cursor.

disk_reads_total.description: Cumulative number of disk reads for this child cursor.

disk_reads_delta.description: Delta number of disk reads for this child cursor.

buffer_gets_total.description: Cumulative number of buffer gets for this child cursor.

buffer_gets_delta.description: Delta number of buffer gets for this child cursor.

rows_processed_total.description: Cumulative number of rows the parsed SQL statement returns.

rows_processed_delta.description: Delta number of rows the parsed SQL statement returns.

cpu_time_total.description: Cumulative value of CPU time (in microseconds) used by this cursor for parsing/executing/fetching.

cpu_time_delta.description: Delta value of CPU time (in microseconds) used by this cursor for parsing/executing/fetching.

elapsed_time_total.description: Cumulative value of elapsed time (in microseconds) used by this cursor for parsing/executing/fetching. If the cursor uses parallel execution, then ELAPSED_TIME_TOTAL is the cumulative time for the query coordinator, plus all parallel query slave processes.

elapsed_time_delta.description: Delta value of elapsed time (in microseconds) used by this cursor for parsing/executing/fetching.

iowait_total.description: Cumulative value of user I/O wait time (in microseconds).

iowait_delta.description: Delta value of user I/O wait time (in microseconds).

clwait_total.description: Cumulative value of cluster wait time (in microseconds).

clwait_delta.description: Delta value of cluster wait time (in microseconds).

apwait_total.description: Cumulative value of application wait time (in microseconds).

apwait_delta.description: Delta value of application wait time (in microseconds).

ccwait_total.description: Cumulative value of concurrency wait time (in microseconds).

ccwait_delta.description: Delta value of concurrency wait time (in microseconds).

plsexec_time_total.description: Cumulative value of PL/SQL Execution Time (in microseconds).

plsexec_time_delta.description: Delta value of PL/SQL Execution Time (in microseconds).

javexec_time_total.description: Cumulative value of Java Execution Time (in microseconds).

javexec_time_delta.description: Delta value of Java Execution Time (in microseconds).

io_offload_elig_bytes_total.description: Cumulative value of number of I/O bytes which can be filtered by the Exadata storage system.

io_offload_elig_bytes_delta.description: Delta value of number of I/O bytes which can be filtered by the Exadata storage system.

io_interconnect_bytes_total.description: Cumulative value of number of I/O bytes exchanged between Oracle Database and the storage system.

io_interconnect_bytes_delta.description: Delta value of number of I/O bytes exchanged between Oracle Database and the storage system.

physical_read_requests_total.description: Cumulative value of number of physical read I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

physical_read_requests_delta.description: Delta value of number of physical read I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

physical_read_bytes_total.description: Cumulative value of number of bytes read from disks by the monitored SQL.

physical_read_bytes_delta.description: Delta value of number of bytes read from disks by the monitored SQL.

physical_write_requests_total.description: Cumulative value of number of physical write I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

physical_write_requests_delta.description: Delta value of number of physical write I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

physical_write_bytes_total.description: Cumulative value of number of bytes written to disks by the monitored SQL.

physical_write_bytes_delta.description: Delta value of number of bytes written to disks by the monitored SQL.

optimized_physical_reads_total.description: Cumulative value of number of physical reads from the Database Smart Flash Cache or the Exadata Smart Flash Cache by the monitored SQL.

optimized_physical_reads_delta.description: Delta value of number of physical reads from the Database Smart Flash Cache or the Exadata Smart Flash Cache by the monitored SQL.

cell_uncompressed_bytes_total.description: Cumulative value of number of uncompressed bytes (that is, size after decompression) that are offloaded to the Exadata cells.

cell_uncompressed_bytes_delta.description: Delta value of number of uncompressed bytes (that is, size after decompression) that are offloaded to the Exadata cells.

io_offload_return_bytes_total.description: Cumulative value of number of bytes that are returned by the Exadata cell for smart scan only (that is, not including bytes for other database I/O).

io_offload_return_bytes_delta.description: Delta value of number of bytes that are returned by the Exadata cell for smart scan only (that is, not including bytes for other database I/O).

con_dbid.description: The database ID of the PDB for the sampled session.

con_id.description: The ID of the container that CON_DBID identifies.

elapsed_time_delta_s_per_exec.description: Average elapsed time (in seconds) for parsing/executing/fetching across all recorded executions.

sum_executions_delta.description: Total of all executions that took place on this object since it was brought into the library cache.

sql_id.description: SQL identifier of the parent cursor in the library cache.

sharable_mem.description: Amount of shared memory used by the child cursor (in bytes).

persistent_mem.description: Fixed amount of memory used for the lifetime of the child cursor (in bytes).

runtime_mem.description: Fixed amount of memory required during the execution of the child cursor.

sorts.description: Number of sorts that were done for the child cursor.

loaded_versions.description: Indicates whether the context heap is loaded (1) or not (0).

open_versions.description: Indicates whether the child cursor is locked (1) or not (0).

users_opening.description: Number of users that have any of the child cursors open.

fetches.description: Number of fetches associated with the SQL statement.

executions.description: Number of executions that took place on this object since it was brought into the library cache.

px_servers_executions.description: Total number of executions performed by parallel execution servers (0 when the statement has never been executed in parallel).

end_of_fetch_count.description: Number of times this cursor was fully executed since the cursor was brought into the library cache. The value of this statistic is not incremented when the cursor is partially executed, either because it failed during the execution or because only the first few rows produced by this cursor are fetched before the cursor is closed or re-executed. By definition, the value of the END_OF_FETCH_COUNT column should be less or equal to the value of the EXECUTIONS column.

users_executing.description: Number of users executing the statement.

loads.description: Number of times the object was either loaded or reloaded.

first_load_time.description: Timestamp of the parent creation time.

invalidations.description: Number of times this child cursor has been invalidated.

parse_calls.description: Number of parse calls for this child cursor.

disk_reads.description: Number of disk reads for this child cursor.

direct_writes.description: Number of direct writes for this child cursor.

direct_reads.description: Number of direct reads for this child cursor.

buffer_gets.description: Number of buffer gets for this child cursor.

rows_processed.description: Total number of rows the parsed SQL statement returns.

optimizer_mode.description: Mode under which the SQL statement was executed.

optimizer_cost.description: Cost of this query given by the optimizer.

optimizer_env_hash_value.description: Hash value for the optimizer environment.

parsing_user_id.description: User ID of the user who originally built this child cursor.

parsing_schema_id.description: Schema ID that was used to originally build this child cursor.

parsing_schema_name.description: Schema name that was used to originally build this child cursor.

kept_versions.description: Indicates whether this child cursor has been marked to be kept pinned in the cache using the DBMS_SHARED_POOL package.

address.description: Address of the handle to the parent for this cursor.

type_chk_heap.description: Descriptor of the type check heap for this child cursor.

hash_value.description: Hash value of the parent statement in the library cache.

plan_hash_value.description: Numeric representation of the current SQL plan for this cursor. Comparing one PLAN_HASH_VALUE to another easily identifies whether or not two plans are the same (rather than comparing the two plans line by line).

full_plan_hash_value.description: Numeric representation of the complete SQL plan for this cursor. Comparing one FULL_PLAN_HASH_VALUE to another easily identifies whether or not two plans are the same (rather than comparing the two plans line by line). Note that the FULL_PLAN_HASH_VALUE cannot be compared across databases releases. It is not backward compatible.

service_hash.description: Hash value for the name listed in the SERVICE column.

module.description: Contains the name of the module that was executing when the SQL statement was first parsed, which is set by calling DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_MODULE.

module_hash.description: Hash value of the module listed in the MODULE column.

action.description: Contains the name of the action that was executing when the SQL statement was first parsed, which is set by calling DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_ACTION.

action_hash.description: Hash value of the action listed in the ACTION column.

serializable_aborts.description: Number of times the transaction failed to serialize, producing ORA-08177 errors, per cursor.

outline_category.description: If an outline was applied during construction of the cursor, then this column displays the category of that outline. Otherwise the column is left blank.

cpu_time.description: CPU time (in microseconds) used by this cursor for parsing, executing, and fetching.

elapsed_time.description: Elapsed time (in microseconds) used by this cursor for parsing, executing, and fetching. If the cursor uses parallel execution, then ELAPSED_TIME is the cumulative time for the query coordinator, plus all parallel query slave processes.

sqltype.description: Denotes the version of the SQL language used for this statement.

remote.description: Indicates whether the cursor is remote mapped (Y) or not (N).

literal_hash_value.description: Hash value of the literals which are replaced with system-generated bind variables and are to be matched, when CURSOR_SHARING is used. This is not the hash value for the SQL statement. If CURSOR_SHARING is not used, then the value is 0.

last_load_time.description: Time at which the query plan was loaded into the library cache.

is_obsolete.description: Indicates whether the cursor has become obsolete (Y) or not (N). This can happen if the number of child cursors is too large.

is_bind_sensitive.description: Indicates whether the cursor is bind sensitive (Y) or not (N). A query is considered bind-sensitive if the optimizer peeked at one of its bind variable values when computing predicate selectivities and where a change in a bind variable value may cause the optimizer to generate a different plan.

is_bind_aware.description: Indicates whether the cursor is bind aware (Y) or not (N). A query is considered bind-aware if it has been marked to use extended cursor sharing. The query would already have been marked as bind-sensitive.

is_shareable.description: Indicates whether the cursor can be shared (Y) or not (N).

child_latch.description: Child latch number that is protecting the cursor. This column is obsolete and maintained for backward compatibility.

sql_profile.description: SQL profile used for this statement, if any.

sql_patch.description: SQL patch used for this statement, if any.

sql_plan_baseline.description: SQL plan baseline used for this statement, if any.

exact_matching_signature.description: Signature calculated on the normalized SQL text. The normalization includes the removal of white space and the uppercasing of all non-literal strings.

force_matching_signature.description: Signature used when the CURSOR_SHARING parameter is set to FORCE.

last_active_time.description: TIme at which the query plan was last active.

io_cell_offload_eligible_bytes.description: Number of I/O bytes which can be filtered by the Exadata storage system.

io_interconnect_bytes.description: Number of I/O bytes exchanged between Oracle Database and the storage system.

physical_read_requests.description: Number of physical read I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

physical_read_bytes.description: Number of bytes read from disks by the monitored SQL.

physical_write_requests.description: Number of physical write I/O requests issued by the monitored SQL.

physical_write_bytes.description: Number of bytes written to disks by the monitored SQL.

optimized_phy_read_requests.description: Number of physical read I/O requests from Database Smart Flash Cache issued by the monitored SQL.

locked_total.description: Total number of times the child cursor has been locked.

pinned_total.description: Total number of times the child cursor has been pinned.

io_cell_uncompressed_bytes.description: Number of uncompressed bytes (that is, size after decompression) that are offloaded to the Exadata cells.

io_cell_offload_returned_bytes.description: Number of filtered bytes returned by Exadata cells (that is, the number of bytes returned after  processing has been offloaded on the Exadata cells).

con_id.description: The ID of the container to which the data pertains.

is_reoptimizable.description: This columns shows whether the next execution matching this child cursor will trigger a reoptimization.

is_resolved_adaptive_plan.description: This column shows whether all of the adaptive parts of a plan have been resolved to the final plan. Once the plan is resolved, the plan hash value and the plan displayed by DBMS_XPLAN will not change through the end of execution.

im_scans.description: Number of In-Memory Column Store (IM column store) segment scans.

im_scan_bytes_uncompressed.description: Uncompressed size of data scanned from the IM column store.

im_scan_bytes_inmemory.description: In-memory size of data scanned from the IM column store.

ddl_no_invalidate.description: Indicates if a DDL statement updated a dependent object and did not invalidate this cursor.

is_rolling_invalid.description: Indicates if this cursor is rolling validated.

is_rolling_refresh_invalid.description: Indicates if this cursor is rolling validated and requires execution time refresh.

result_cache.description: Indicates whether the function is result???cached (YES) or not (NO).
